category_title: Difficult students who alternate between ostentatious task engagement and masked transgressive play
scenario_title: Jumping workshop with ostentatious engagement and masked play
minimal_context: The student is waiting in line at the 'Jumping over' workshop in gymnastics class to practice straight jumps over the horse.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, we are at the 'Jumping over' workshop. Please line up and practice your straight jumps over the horse.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Teacher, look! I'm doing the exercise. Is it good? I need help for the stall turn so you can see I'm working!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Yes, that is fine. Keep practicing your jumps while I go check on the other group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks towards the teacher) There I make the jump, it's easy, I'm going to have fun. (Insults Aris as he prepares to jump over the horse, causing Aris to miss and fall).

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What is going on over there? Please just do the straight jumps like I asked.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sees the teacher leaving) The teacher can't see us, he's looking in the other direction. Let's play at who will do the most spectacular jump! (Attempts a somersault instead of a straight jump).

task.content: Executing a jump in the 'Jumping over' workshop and stall turn

context.environment: Gymnastics classes, organized into small workshops... systematically organized the workshops along the wall of the gym
context.social_setting: Waiting in line at the 'Jumping over' workshop while the teacher is occupied with another group.
